opening: You went down at your own door, on the side of it where the work had been done.

clauses.text: The walls had turned it away before — more than once, on nights nobody was awake to count. They did not owe you another one.
They had been through those walls once before, and you had gone on living there anyway, which is the part of it worth remembering.
Inside there were rooms you had made mean something — a place to cook, a place to keep water, a place that was not just out of the rain.
The work you had started was still standing half-done behind you, close enough that anyone coming after could see what it was going to be.
You had held that address for days by then, which in what is left of this city is a long tenancy.
You did not go quietly and it was not cheap for them.
Nothing you did to keep that door shut was anything you would have needed to lie about afterwards.
You had done harder things than this to keep that door shut, and at the end it was the door that mattered to you, not the things.
There was somebody behind you when it took you, and the door held long enough to be worth standing in.
There was nobody behind you. You stood in it anyway.
